title: thelypteris rubra
intro: Thelypteris rubra, commonly known as the Red Maiden's Hair, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris rubra include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
